rules.what_this_is: The rules Recon decides with. A person can change any of these; recon rules prints them; every run uses them as they are.

quantity.rule: never pay for more than has arrived: what is billed on an order line can't exceed what was received on it

freight.on_the_order: same rule as price, against the order's estimate

tax.rule: never computed; tax on a bill whose order expected none is held

total.rule: lines plus freight plus tax equal the stated total, to the cent

payments.rule: a payment must name its invoice and match it to the cent; a payment that names none is held, with the matching invoice suggested

duplicates.rule: same supplier and the same number (ignoring spaces, dashes and leading zeros); or the same supplier, order line and amount with no new delivery since

different_payee.rule: a bill from a company other than the one the order was placed with is never cleared

ai.rule: the AI reads each document twice; an answer counts only when both readings agree and the AI is sure, and anything else is held for a person

no_order_suppliers.rule: a supplier on file as always billing without an order (rent, software) is set aside for a person; Recon does not match it

rules.cleared_means: ready for a person to pay; Recon pays nothing and sends nothing

wording.what_this_is: Every sentence Recon builds from data: the short reason on a held row, the full reason, and the drafted note. Code fills the [names]; the AI writes none of these.
